title: Madrid Residency Night 6 — "Como Antes" Exclusive; 384,000+ Fans Through Six Sold-Out Nights
detail: Bad Bunny performs Night 6 of his 10-night Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid before 64,000 fans — the closing show of Cluster 3 (June 6–7). The exclusive song for Night 6 is 'Como Antes,' the nostalgic DTMF ballad with Jorge Drexler and Carlos Sadness. Six of the ten sold-out nights are now complete; cumulative attendance across Nights 1–6 reaches approximately 384,000 fans. The residency's final two clusters remain: Cluster 4 (June 10–11) and Cluster 5 (June 14–15). The June 6–7 weekend saw Madrid simultaneously host Pope Leo XIV's first apostolic visit to Spain and Bad Bunny's residency third cluster — the Pope's viral quip about competition for Madrid audiences dominated international entertainment press through the weekend. The DtMF World Tour continues after Madrid: Düsseldorf (June 20–21), Arnhem (June 23–24), London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium (June 27–28 — first-ever UK stadium dates), and Brussels (July 22). 'DtMF' remains at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs for its 62nd consecutive week (chart dated June 6, 2026), continuing to extend the all-time chart record. Pixar's *Toy Story 5*, in which Bad Bunny voices 'Pizza with Sunglasses,' opens in theaters in 12 days (June 19, 2026).
